inboundReceivers.catalogEntry: _0x0137 / SetActorPropertyPacket / Set Actor Work Values, SyncMemory (MapServerOpcode::SetActorProperty)
inboundReceivers.bodyShape: property-stream: header + sequence of records, each with a 1-byte type tag (record-update for bVar1 < DAT_00fe059b; property-set for bVar1 < DAT_00fe05a0; end-marker for bVar1 < DAT_00fe05a1; terminator otherwise)
inboundReceivers.dispatchShape: 42-insn slot1; no cast; canonical Receiver construct/apply/destruct chain (FUN_0xcc7510 init helper / FUN_0xcc73b0 / FUN_0x775a30 apply / FUN_0xcc9330 dtor helper); the receiver instance is constructed on stack via FUN_0089f4c0 then destructed via FUN_0089e6e0
inboundReceivers.evidence: constructor_verification:FUN_0089f4c0 EXPLICITLY writes 'Application::Lua::Script::Client::Command::Network::SyncMemoryReceiver::vftable' at param_1[0] (after first writing CommandInterface::vftable as part of the base-class chain); FUN_0089e6e0 EXPLICITLY writes the same vtable then resets to CommandInterface::vftable - canonical construct/destruct sequence. Wrapper FUN_00759ed0 at LuaActorImpl::vftable[60] follows construct->apply->destruct (FUN_0089f4c0 / FUN_0089e550 / FUN_0089e6e0). Handler chain FUN_00775a30 -> FUN_00775180 iterates the property stream with per-record 1-byte type-tag dispatch against thresholds DAT_00fe059b / DAT_00fe05a0 / DAT_00fe05a1 (NOT a single-property sentinel - dispatch is per-record-type, with three type bands routing to record-update / property-set / end-marker branches). The Set Actor Work Values (SyncMemory) label aligns with this property-stream semantic. BCS-Y-0075 MurmurHash2Backward documents 0x0137 as the property-id stream that this receiver consumes in full. SUPERSEDES CANDIDATE: the 'sentinel property-id' framing was a misread - 0x0137 always feeds SyncMemoryReceiver, internal dispatch is per-record type-tag not per-opcode sentinel.
